title: MentalArena v0.7 Conflict Extraction Diagnostic
purpose: Narrow diagnostic pack for testing whether conflict extraction is worth building further.

blocks.title: Core product
blocks.text: Conflict extraction is the core product. Parallel dispatch and logging are useful but not differentiating. Judge panels, memory, and multi-round loops are architecture perfume unless conflict extraction proves itself first.

blocks.title: Minimal workflow
blocks.text: Minimal v0.7 workflow: seed.md → 3 to 5 answer models → raw responses → conflict_extraction.md with up to 5 conflicts → BD selects 0 to 3 conflicts → optional targeted critique → final_report.md → metrics.json and lineage.json.

blocks.title: Baseline comparisons
blocks.text: Compare against BD manual workflow and against a strong single-model reflection baseline. Do not allow MentalArena to win only against a weak comparison.

blocks.title: Kill criteria
blocks.text: Pause or pivot if conflict maps are mostly wording differences, BD still must read all raw outputs, final synthesis is bland consensus, best raw answer beats synthesis, or cost/time exceed value.

blocks.title: Semantic bleaching risk
blocks.text: Repeated critique/synthesis can flatten sharp contrarian insight into safe consensus. MentalArena should preserve useful disagreement, not just average models.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
